title: Reef Memory

subtitle._comment: Header line under the title. {count} is the number of species in the game.
subtitle.one: A memory game with {count} reef animal photographed on iNaturalist.
subtitle.other: A memory game with {count} reef animals photographed on iNaturalist.

machine_note._comment: Small note beside the language picker, shown only for translations not yet checked by a native speaker.
machine_note.text: This translation hasn't been reviewed by a native speaker yet.

pairs_label._comment: Label before the 8 / 12 / 18 buttons that pick how many pairs a dive deals.

new_dive._comment: Button that deals a new board. A round of the game is called a dive.

moves._comment: Counter pill. A move is turning over two cards.

found._comment: Counter pill. {count} pairs found so far out of {pairs} (always 8, 12 or 18).

cleared_in._comment: Counter pill once every pair is found. {count} is the number of moves.

board_label._comment: Screen-reader label for the grid of cards.
board_label.text: Memory cards. Arrow keys move between cards.

card_down._comment: Screen-reader label for a card. {n} is its position on the board.

status_start._comment: Status line at the start of a dive. {pairs} is 8, 12 or 18; {count} is the number of species in the game.
status_start.one: Each dive is a random {pairs} of {count} reef animal. Flip two cards to start.
status_start.other: Each dive is a random {pairs} of {count} reef animals. Flip two cards to start.

status_find_pair._comment: Status line after the first card of a move. Text between ** is shown bold; keep the markers.

status_match._comment: Status line after a match. {count} pairs found so far out of {pairs}. Text between ** is shown bold.

status_miss._comment: Status line when the two cards differ. {first} and {second} are animal names.

status_cleared._comment: Status line after the last match. {count} is the number of moves. Text between ** is shown bold.

status_abandon._comment: Shown when New dive or another size is pressed mid-dive; a second press confirms. Text between ** is shown bold.
status_abandon.text: **Press again to abandon this dive.** Your progress will be lost.

status_in_progress._comment: Shown when the abandon prompt times out. {count} pairs found so far out of {pairs}.

facts_label._comment: Screen-reader label for the panel that shows an animal's fact.

sheet_intro._comment: Placeholder in the fact panel before the first match (wide screens only).
sheet_intro.text: Match a pair and the animal's story surfaces here.

observations._comment: Number of sightings of the species recorded on iNaturalist.

species_page._comment: Link to the species page on iNaturalist.

photo_by._comment: Photo credit. {photographer} becomes a link to the photo page.

unknown_photographer._comment: Credit used when a photo has no photographer name.

photo_label._comment: Screen-reader label for the enlarged photo dialog.

won_summary._comment: Win panel. {pairs} is 8, 12 or 18; {count} is the number of moves taken.
won_summary.one: {pairs} pairs in {count} move. A perfect dive is {pairs}.
won_summary.other: {pairs} pairs in {count} moves. A perfect dive is {pairs}.

won_best_new: That's your best at this size.

won_best._comment: Win panel when the player didn't beat their record. {count} is the best number of moves.

back_to_pairs._comment: Win panel button that goes back to the smallest board. {pairs} is 8.

try_pairs._comment: Win panel button for the next bigger board. {pairs} is 12 or 18.

log_title._comment: Heading over the list of animals matched in this dive.

log_hint: Matched animals collect here. Select one, or a matched card, to read its fact again.

about_text._comment: {inaturalist} becomes a link with the name iNaturalist.
about_text.text: Photos and observation counts come from {inaturalist} open data. Each photo keeps its own license; follow a credit to see its photo page.
